title: Batelco and Ericsson expand 5G coverage and introduce Artificial Intelligence network capabilities in Bahrain
summary: Batelco and Ericsson expand 5G coverage and introduce AI-powered network capabilities across Bahrain.
body_markdown:
Ericsson (NASDAQ: ERIC) and Batelco by Beyon are strengthening their partnership to expand and modernize Batelco’s mobile broadband network across Bahrain.


The collaboration combines Ericsson radio access network (RAN) and cloud-native core technologies to strengthen network coverage, capacity and performance. It also includes trials of Ericsson’s AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation, an AI-powered capability designed to improve radio network efficiency, deliver better data rates and user experience.


This supports Batelco’s ambition to deliver faster, more reliable connectivity and enhanced digital experiences for consumers and businesses, while preparing its network for 6G future introduction in the Kingdom.


As part of the expansion, Batelco will deploy Ericsson’s latest radio access network (RAN) solutions, including high-performing Massive MIMO radios that improve downlink performance and energy efficiency while reducing the hardware footprint. The deployment will help strengthen coverage and capacity, supporting more consistent connectivity and improved mobile experiences.


In parallel, Batelco will modernize its core network with Ericsson’s cloud-native dual-mode 5G Core solution, upgrading its packet core and Unified Data Management systems. It will also evolve its cloud infrastructure, moving from NFVi to Ericsson Cloud Native Infrastructure Solution, ensuring it is fully prepared for the next phases of cloud-native transformation. The modernization will help Batelco manage growing data demands and deliver more reliable digital services. and a flexible foundation for advanced connectivity services.


**Maitham Abdulla Batelco by Beyon CEO** , commented: “Our continued investment in expanding and modernizing our network reflects our commitment to delivering an exceptional connectivity experience across Bahrain. By enhancing coverage and capacity while introducing advanced technologies, we are building a more intelligent and efficient network that meets the evolving needs of consumers and businesses. Our collaboration with Ericsson reinforces our commitment to supporting Bahrain’s digital transformation ambitions.”


**Petra Schirren, President of Ericsson Gulf Region** , says: “Our collaboration with Batelco brings together advanced radio solutions, AI-enabled capabilities and cloud-native technologies to enhance network performance and customer experiences. By expanding connectivity, advancing 5G Standalone readiness and exploring 5G-Advanced capabilities, we are supporting Batelco in building a more intelligent, efficient and future-ready network, creating opportunities for innovation and laying the foundation for 6G.”


The collaboration reinforces Batelco and Ericsson’s commitment to advancing Bahrain’s digital infrastructure and supporting Bahrain Economic Vision 2030. By combining enhanced mobile connectivity with intelligent and cloud-native network technologies, the companies are helping build a future-ready network to support the Kingdom’s evolving digital needs.
